deep.reconstruction: This page has no mathematics. The previous page of the dossier held a lemma on 1-dimensional arrangements of N pseudo-lines without bigonal double points, with types II_4, II_5, II_{3,2}, III_6 and III_7. This sheet is something else: page '2' of a personal, introspective text in German, misfiled or interleaved in the pseudo-line dossier. Grothendieck is deciding how to proceed with a 'spontaneous' self-examination ('völlige Spontaneität der Untersuchung'). He considers starting from any period of his life, for instance the correspondence with Hanka (his mother, Johanna 'Hanka' Grothendieck) since 1942. He also considers examining his relationship with her up to her death (1957), which he says he has 'never yet looked at more closely'. Doing so would be a 'hinge' (Scharnier) between the work of the 'last seven months' and the work ahead, and might yield an 'Ariadne's thread' (Ariane-faden) leading further back into his childhood or forward into his adult life. The page breaks off: 'Doch bevor ich mich eingehend mit irgend einer Periode oder einer Frage bez. meines Lebens aus[einandersetze]...'. This places it within the meditative or autobiographical writing of about 1979–1981, the period of his reflections on his parents. It is consistent with the dossier date '[à partir de 1981]'.
